claim: Macie stores sensitive data discovery results for only 90 days; for long-term storage and retention you configure Macie to encrypt them with an AWS KMS key and store them in an S3 bucket. These repository settings apply only to the current AWS Region (and, for a Macie administrator, only to its own account), so you configure them in each Region where you use Macie.

evidence.quote: Macie stores your sensitive data discovery results for only 90 days. To access your results and enable long-term storage and retention of them, configure Macie to encrypt the results with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key and store them in an S3 bucket.
When you configure the settings in Macie, your choices apply only to the current AWS Region. If you're the Macie administrator for an organization, your choices apply only to your account.
If you use Macie in multiple AWS Regions, configure the repository settings for each Region in which you use Macie.
